class TestCacheProfiles(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cache_key_includes_all_three_identifiers(self):
        store = {}
        user_id = "u1"
        job_id = "j1"
        
        # First call with profile_version 1
        score1 = get_score(store, user_id, job_id, "v1", lambda: 10)
        self.assertEqual(score1, 10)
        
        # Second call with same profile_version should be cache hit (no compute called)
        # We verify by checking that store has only one entry
        self.assertEqual(len(store), 1)
        
        # Third call with different profile_version should be cache miss
        score2 = get_score(store, user_id, job_id, "v2", lambda: 20)
        self.assertEqual(score2, 20)
        
        # Now store should have 2 entries
        self.assertEqual(len(store), 2)
    
    def test_cache_hits_do_not_call_compute(self):
        """Cache hits (including zero) must not call compute."""
        store = {}
        
        # Call with a compute that we can track via side effect
        computed_values = []
        
        def tracking_compute():
            computed_values.append(42)
            return 42
        
        # First call - should compute
        get_score(store, "u1", "j1", "v1", tracking_compute)
        self.assertEqual(len(computed_values), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(store), 1)
        
        # Second call - should be cache hit, no compute
        computed_values.clear()
        get_score(store, "u1", "j1", "v1", tracking_compute)
        self.assertEqual(len(computed_values), 0)
        self.assertEqual(len(store), 1)
    
    def test_different_users_create_separate_cache_entries(self):
        store = {}
        
        # Different user should have separate entry
        get_score(store, "u1", "j1", "v1", lambda: 10)
        get_score(store, "u2", "j1", "v1", lambda: 20)
        
        self.assertEqual(len(store), 2)
    
    def test_different_jobs_create_separate_cache_entries(self):
        store = {}
        
        # Different job should have separate entry
        get_score(store, "u1", "j1", "v1", lambda: 10)
        get_score(store, "u1", "j2", "v1", lambda: 20)
        
        self.assertEqual(len(store), 2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
